research_question: Predict enzyme reaction kinetic constants (Km, kcat, kcat/Km) from reaction identity and assay conditions.

fields.name: cofactor
fields.definition: cofactor/metal ion present in the assay as reported

fields.name: measurement_kind
fields.definition: whether the kinetic value is experimentally measured (default tier) or computational/predicted (segregated stratum, E11)

fields.name: kinetics_stratum
fields.definition: kinetics model class; non-MM/inhibited/allosteric are retained but segregated from the default regression view (E12)

inclusion_exclusion.include: measured steady-state Michaelis-Menten kinetic constants (default regression tier)
inclusion_exclusion.computational: predicted/computational values retained as a separate stratum (measurement_kind='computational'), excluded from default view
inclusion_exclusion.exclude: none by provenance; non-MM/inhibited/allosteric segregated via kinetics_stratum, not dropped

negative_data_policy: Retain non-MM / inhibited / allosteric cases flagged via kinetics_stratum; retain computational values flagged via measurement_kind. Default regression view = measured + michaelis_menten only. Nothing discarded (mirrors BBB two-tier).

items.summary: Research question: catalog enzyme reaction kinetic constants (Km, kcat, kcat/Km) with conditions.
Entity class in scope: enzyme-substrate pairs (a reaction), not whole proteins.
ML task = REGRESSION on continuous kinetic targets (Km, kcat, kcat/Km).
Primary regression targets: km_value, kcat_value, kcat_km_value (each with unit + log-transform note).
items.edit_note: kcat_km_value valid_range lower bound recalibrated 0.01 -> 1e-4 (researcher-ratified 2026-07-19). The agent-proposed 0.01 clipped 4 real curated slow-enzyme efficiencies (0.0018-0.0039 M^-1 s^-1) from the SABIO-RK pilot. The lower bound is a sanity floor (reject zero/negative/unit-error values), not a biological prior; 1e-4 admits observed slow enzymes with ~18x margin.

items.summary: Entity identity: EC number + UniProt accession (enzyme) + substrate InChIKey (ChEBI cross-ref).
Conditioning variables (regression features): pH, temperature (C), organism, mutant/wildtype, buffer, cofactor.
items.edit_note: Researcher ratified 2026-07-14: materialize buffer and cofactor as fields in addition to pH/temperature/organism/mutant (proposal named them in summary only).

items.summary: Unit of analysis: one row = one (enzyme, substrate, parameter, condition_set, source).
Unit normalization: Km->uM, kcat->s^-1, kcat/Km->M^-1 s^-1; store raw+normalized.
Vocab bindings: EC (IUBMB), UniProt, ChEBI/InChIKey for substrate identity.
Dual adapter: literature (enzymology papers) + structured-data (SABIO-RK, BRENDA).
Inclusion: measured steady-state Michaelis-Menten constants form the default tier; computational/predicted values RETAINED as a separate stratum (not excluded).
items.edit_note: Researcher ratified 2026-07-14: upgraded from 'exclude computational' to 'retain computational as a separate stratum' (mirrors two-tier segregation pattern).

items.summary: Negative/edge policy: retain non-Michaelis-Menten & inhibited/allosteric cases flagged; segregate from default regression view.
